mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM OVERDUE o JOIN USER u ON o.uidx = u.uidx WHERE u.userNumber = #{userNumber} AND o.status = 'Y' ) THEN CONCAT('이용불가(~', (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(MAX(o2.endDate), '%Y.%m.%d') FROM OVERDUE o2 JOIN USER u2 ON o2.uidx = u2.uidx WHERE u2.userNumber = #{userNumber} AND o2.status = 'Y' ), ')') ELSE '이용가능' END AS loanStatus FROM USER u WHERE u.userNumber = #{userNumber};

SELECT l.lidx, b.coverImg, b.title, b.author, lb.code, DATE_FORMAT(l.loanDate, '%Y.%m.%d') AS loanDate, DATE_FORMAT(l.dueDate, '%Y.%m.%d') AS dueDate, CASE WHEN l.returnDate IS NOT NULL THEN DATE_FORMAT(l.returnDate, '%Y.%m.%d') ELSE '-' END AS returnDate, l.status, l.delyn FROM LOAN l JOIN USER u ON l.uidx = u.uidx JOIN LIBRARYBOOKS lb ON l.lbidx = lb.lbidx JOIN BOOKS b ON lb.bidx = b.bidx WHERE u.userNumber = #{userNumber} AND l.delyn = 'N' ORDER BY l.loanDate DESC LIMIT #{startPageNum}, #{perPageNum}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LOAN l JOIN USER u ON l.uidx = u.uidx WHERE u.userNumber = #{userNumber}
mapper.update: UPDATE OVERDUE SET status = 'N' WHERE status = 'Y' AND endDate <= CURRENT_DATE()
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO LOAN (uidx, lbidx, loanDate, dueDate, status) VALUES ( (SELECT uidx FROM USER WHERE userNumber = #{userNumber}), (SELECT lbidx FROM LIBRARYBOOKS WHERE code = #{code}), NOW(), DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 6 DAY), '대출중' )
mapper.update: UPDATE LIBRARYBOOKS SET status = '대출중', loanDate = NOW(), dueDate = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 6 DAY), returnDate = NULL, modify = NOW() WHERE code = #{code}
UPDATE LIBRARYBOOKS SET status = '대출가능', loanDate = NULL, dueDate = NULL, returnDate = NOW(), modify = NOW() WHERE lbidx = ( SELECT lbidx FROM LOAN WHERE lidx = #{lidx} )
UPDATE LOAN SET status = #{status}, returnDate = NOW(), modify = NOW() WHERE lidx = #{lidx}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OVERDUE (lidx, uidx, status, startDate, endDate) VALUES ( #{lidx}, (SELECT uidx FROM LOAN WHERE lidx = #{lidx}), 'Y', NOW(), DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL ( (SELECT DATEDIFF(NOW(), dueDate) FROM LOAN WHERE lidx = #{lidx}) * 2 + 1 ) DAY) )
